title: dysoxylum salutare
intro: Dysoxylum salutare, commonly known as  White Alder, is a plant species found in the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various diseases such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Dysoxylum salutare include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and prevent the formation of pus in wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
